mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatMessage (msgIdx, roomIdx, userIdx, content, msgType, sendDate) VALUES (chatMsgSeq.NEXTVAL, #{roomIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{content}, #{msgType}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT m.msgIdx, m.roomIdx, m.userIdx, m.content, m.msgType, TO_CHAR(m.sendDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS sendDate, u.nickname, u.profile_photo AS profilePhoto FROM chatMessage m JOIN users u ON m.userIdx = u.userIdx WHERE m.roomIdx = #{roomIdx} ORDER BY m.msgIdx ASC
